findings.claim: Bloomberg consensus per The Edge (June 2026): 8 analysts, 6 buy / 2 hold, average 12-month TP RM4.40 (vs 11 Jun close RM3.28).

findings.source: NST, Takaful Malaysia set for normalised growth, CIMB cuts to 'Hold'

findings.source: Business Today, Takaful Malaysia 1H26 PBZT rises 6.5%
